URL: https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-july-20-2026/
NOTE: ISW (20 Jul). Ukraine's intermediate-range strike campaign has partially severed the M-14 (R-280) Rostov-Crimea highway GLOC; Russian milbloggers rebutted official claims of "complete control." UN HRMMU: June 2026 civilian casualties highest since April 2022 (293 killed, 1,990 injured); long-range strikes killed 1,396 civilians since 1 Jan. Ukraine struck oil depot in Podolsk + Wildberries warehouse in Domodedovo (Moscow Oblast) night 19-20; Zelensky acknowledged. Ukraine struck 6 air defence systems in Krasnodar Krai; SBU hit FSB hub in occupied Kherson (13 drones, ~100 servicemembers/70 vehicles present). Golden Leo: Russia used 3 Kh-59/69 cruise missiles, killing at least 10 sailors; Russian milblogger says Russia now using heavy anti-ship missiles vs vessels — significant escalation. Overnight Russia launched 2 Kh-59/69 + 94 drones; 81 downed. First guided glide bomb strike on Pavlohrad (80km from front). No confirmed ground advances by either side 20 Jul.
